metadata.title: poppy.ax: the Personal Agent Protocol in plain words
metadata.description: A plain guide to the Personal Agent Protocol (PAP), with a checker that shows whether a site lets people's AI assistants in safely. An independent guide by Ora.

independentLabel.before: An independent guide by Ora. PAP is developed by its authors (Meta and Sierra, with Genesys, Instinct, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe and Walmart) at

license.after: , so anyone can reuse them with credit.

setup.title: Set it up
setup.heading: Set it up, one level at a time
setup.lede: Four levels, and you can stop at any of them. Each one says what to build, roughly how big it is, and which of the checker's rows turn green. Every claim links the section of the spec it comes from.

sites.title: Sites
sites.heading: Sites that publish a PAP file
sites.lede: Every site Ora has seen publishing the protocol's public file, with the date it was first seen. The list arrives on this page soon.
